$comment: Manifest of published legal documents. slug -> source file. The slug is the URL path segment. Read by scripts/gen-legal-pages.cjs (embeds into the edge function) and by scripts/gen-website.cjs (renders the website Legal Centre), so the two can never publish different sets. Order is the order a reader meets them in. Twelve documents were added on 2026-10-02 and four topics were folded into existing pages rather than duplicated as near-identical new ones: Acceptable Use into Community Guidelines, Credits and Virtual Items into Purchases, Training Safety Guidelines into Training and Health Safety, and the Children's Privacy Notice into Child and Young Athlete Safety. This map records which requested topic lives where.
